entities.summary: Sri Peddamma Thalli Temple is a Hindu temple located at Jubilee Hills in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It is very famous during the festive season of Bonaalu. The temple is dedicated to Peddamma, a village form of Vedic goddess Shachi.
